- \(6\) hurricanes: \(2\) years
- \(7\) hurricanes: \(1\) year

Cumulative totals:

\[
5 \quad \text{years with }0
\]
\[
5+14=19 \quad \text{years with at most }1
\]
\[
19+17=36 \quad \text{years with at most }2
\]

The 29th year falls between the 20th and 36th positions, which are all in the “2 hurricanes” category.

The answer is 2.
